name: Cymidei Cymeinfoll

attributes.attribute: a giantess and heroine of Welsh legend
wife of the giant Llassar Llaesgyfnewid
owned by the pair, drives the second branch of the Mabinogion
bears armed fighters every six weeks

sources: Gantz, Jeffrey, trans. *The Mabinogion*. New York: Barnes & Noble Books, 1976, pp. 72, 75, 87.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cymidei Cymeinfoll is a Welsh giantess and a heroine on record. She wed the giant Llassar. The pair owned a cauldron that could restore the dead, and that vessel sets in much of the action found in branch two of the Mabinogi. She brings forth a host of armed legions, whelping a fresh set each pass of six or seven weeks; her translated title names a fighter born of a fine bough.

okr.objective: Cymidei Cymeinfoll is a Welsh giantess linked to a magic cauldron.
